body:
I have been taking mdma recently like once every two weeks for like 6 weeks and I stopped for awhile. Recently I have been feeling what I can only describe as bi-polar. I get really happy and rolly and then like ten minutes later realize that I have to kill myself. It kinda blows. I realize that this is only temporary, at least thats what I'm telling myself. This may be due to the last time I rolled I did not take my usual high dose of st. johns wort. Orange juice does help a little with stabilizing my mood. Just thought I'd share that lil bit of knowledge with you all. I do not regret taking mdma, this side effect is so worth what I learned on MDMA, that the world is an amazing place and that enlightment can not be reached by using drugs, However they do give you a glimpse of the mountaintop.
